chronology.approval_timestamp_disclosure: The bound acceptance records 2026-07-21T00:00:00Z, earlier than truth, review, and candidate publication. Acceptance publication is a descendant of those artifacts and binds their exact hashes. This manifest preserves the mismatch and does not represent the nominal timestamp as lifecycle-order proof.

requirements: Every consumer must bind this exact accepted-manifest digest through the separate accepted-manifest-author receipt.
Every consumer must preserve all twelve disclosures, all excluded uses, and every false completion and behavior claim without narrowing or omission.
Every consumer must remain within the three-package bounded evidence scope, treat all browser behavior as unknown, and retain the fourteen Griffin claims as historical only.
The accepted evidence may not be used as an ontology, cross-game standardization, shared-system, implementation, full-cohort-completion, track-completion, or downstream product decision.
Consumption stops immediately when any automatic revocation trigger is observed.

automatic_triggers: Any byte or SHA-256 change to the bound owner acceptance, candidate, candidate receipt, V2 review, V2 review receipt, V2 truth test, V2 truth receipt, governing input, predecessor, selected input, reviewed output, producer receipt, browser audit, or browser receipt.

Any phase-base, truth-role-base, truth-publication, review-role-base, review-audited-head, review-publication, candidate-role-base, candidate-publication, acceptance-publication, source-baseline, or accepted-manifest-role-base mismatch, or failure of the declared Git ancestor chain.
Revocation, replay, supersession, unresolved state, or authority invalidation of the exact owner acceptance; or revocation or supersession of any bound predecessor or owner direction.

Any later unsupported factual claim, citation-envelope mismatch, semantic-anchor mismatch, denominator mismatch, stale mapper or receipt binding, unexcepted budget breach, changed browser disposition, browser-behavior overclaim, historical-to-current promotion, or unresolved Critical, High, or Medium finding.

Any claim or implication of successful route reachability, movement, transition, responsive behavior, trusted input behavior, completion, persistence, XP award, idempotency, API correctness, production behavior, or asset loading from this accepted evidence.

Any omission, mutation, or misuse of a disclosure, including representation of elapsed_minutes=0 as measured time, stale review arithmetic as a green exact count, the nominal approval timestamp as publication-order proof, historical candidate or review lifecycle language as current state, or owner acceptance as the accepted manifest itself.

Any consumption outside the three-package bounded evidence scope or after a relevant implementation, route, source, evidence, direction, review, acceptance, or lifecycle change without additive supersession and fresh gates.
revocation_rules.on_trigger: Stop consumption immediately. Publish an additive revocation or supersession record naming the exact accepted-manifest SHA-256, mark that digest revoked in successor lifecycle state, regenerate every affected output and receipt, rerun equivalent evidence and lifecycle gates, obtain a fresh zero-blocker independent review and exact product-owner acceptance, then publish a new accepted manifest. Never mutate this manifest, its candidate, its acceptance, or their receipts in place.
